name: Delaware Manufacturing
old_description: Since 1994, DEMEP has been providing world-class services that enable Delaware firms to acquire and apply technologies, utilize new resources, reduce waste, streamline processes and most importantly, drive sales growth.
about:
Delaware Manufacturing Extension Partnership (DEMEP) operates from Newark, Delaware, where it was established in 1994 as a federally and state funded non-profit organization. It serves as the official representative of the MEP National Network in Delaware, operating through Delaware Technical Community College in partnership with the U.S. Department of Commerce's National Institute of Standards and Technology, the Delaware Division of Small Business, and state and local chambers of commerce.

DEMEP delivers consulting, training, and implementation services rather than manufactured products. Its core offerings include Lean Enterprise deployment, Quality Management Systems implementation, Statistical Approach and Six Sigma methodologies, Design of Experiments, Top Line Growth strategy, and Energy Savings Analysis and Audit. The organization provides over 30 specialized training programs ranging from Value Stream Mapping and 5S Workplace Organization to ISO 9001, ISO 14000, ISO/TS 16949, and ISO 14644 standards training, as well as Innovation Engineering, Supply Chain Optimization, and Leadership Development.

The partnership serves Delaware's manufacturing base across multiple sectors, along with financial institutions and health care and service providers. Its client engagements span automotive suppliers requiring ISO/TS 16949 compliance, medical device manufacturers needing ISO 13485 systems, and general manufacturers seeking lean transformation, quality certification, energy reduction, or market growth strategies.

DEMEP was founded with a mandate to transfer Lean Best Practices and Quality Systems Training to the manufacturing community. The organization states its purpose is to improve the global competitiveness of Delaware manufacturers by providing confidential access to industry best practices, processes, and business improvement methodologies through its national network of 51 MEP Centers.
